desc: Destination for artisan ice creams using only fruits, dry fruits, chocolates, milk & sugar.
addr: 2984, 12th Main Rd, near SBI, HAL 2nd Stage, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560008, India

rev.t: After a hearty lunch at the Indiranagar, Bengaluru outlet of ‘Burma Burma Restaurant & Tea Room,’ we wanted to have ice cream as dessert. Therefore, we decided to hit the ‘Naturals Ice Cream’ outlet right opposite the eatery. We thought of …
I have visited Naturals Ice Cream on two different occasions, both during weekends, and overall it has been a good experience. …
My most favourite ice cream parlour. All the flavours are palatable. Mango malai is now in all fvrts. Space is there for seating inside and outside. Tender coconut and sitaphal is my favourite.
